claim: A model that starts from game state and never runs the startup stub cannot see hook code lost under the stub's register block; compare hook bytes after a simulated boot.

evidence.text: Hook code under the stub's register block is lost at boot; models without the stub cannot see it: compare hook bytes after a simulated boot (a register-block crash was fixed).
evidence.quote: at boot; models without the stub cannot see it: compare hook bytes after a simulated boot.

evidence.text: Inferno: the first build crashed (green bars) because hook code at 0x3945-0x3960 sat under the stub's 20-byte register block written at the end of the ROM image; moving the hooks to 0x3960 fixed it.
